limitations: Mobile with a real alpha-tested tree has a nonexact 7-second/reset round trip: 922 changed pixels, 38 > 2/255, peak 7/255. Initial and held frames are exactly stable. The previous build with an explicitly controlled original foliage clock has a similar residual (880 pixels, 40 > 2/255, peak 7/255); it is not an identical-geometry pixel match. No fix of that renderer behavior is claimed.

The combined grass/cover Compatibility rebuild changes one pixel at (433,70), RGB (25,16,8) to (22,17,12). The unchanged previous build reproduces that exact pixel and values. The cover-only view and the combined Forward+ view restore exactly.

Eight 4 cm radial probes retain water coverage, but the pre-existing flooded outer-map mean-plane extrapolation is approximate: 0.469438 m for the full envelope, 0.206243 m after vertex-tip weighting; peak tip-weighted attenuation error 0.02104365 at a different vertex. These are conservative envelopes, not a measured specific weather frame. The worst full-envelope point has tip=0 and is fixed by the real shader. Flat sampled water has zero extrapolation error.

All GPU tests are desktop RTX 3090 runs. Mobile means the desktop Vulkan Mobile renderer, not an Android device. Other user Godot processes were left untouched and listed per run. No FPS, battery, Android/web, or memory-bandwidth win is claimed.

The helper covers vegetation only. Original rain/snow trajectories, water geometry, weather events and gameplay randomness remain unchanged. Cloud/fog/ambient-particle wind, actual submission LOD and regional cover sets remain separate work. Desktop sun policy remains continuous; handheld/web held policy is unchanged.
